kitEvidence.formula: Soraka calls upon divine powers, restoring [150 / 250 / 350 + (0.5) × AP] Health to all allied champions, regardless of distance. Healing is increased to [(150 / 250 / 350 + (0.5) × AP) × ((1 + 0.5))] on targets below 40% Health.
